messages:
ari: Need a tight one-pager for next week's "Enterprise Deployment Snapshot" webinar. Goal: 1-pager that helps field quickly recommend Hosted / Dedicated / Private based on security, SLAs, cost signals, and inbound routing. Keep language punchy.

marco: Agreed. Field asks for a 3-row tile (Security | SLA | When to pick) for each mode, plus a tiny decision tree for SDRs. Also include two bench callouts: p99 latency and per-token cost delta at scale.

tess: I'll write the tiles. Draft lines: Hosted = quick start, lower entry cost, managed security; Dedicated = reserved throughput, stronger SLA, tenant isolation; Private = full isolation, customer-controlled KMS & network.

ari: Perfect. Marco, can you paste bench figures? We need rounded public-friendly numbers.

marco: From bench notes: p99 gen latency (8k context): Hosted ~420ms, Dedicated tuned ~270ms. Cost: Dedicated ~25% lower per-token at steady high volume. Private depends on infra. I'll put those in the doc as "typical" not guaranteed.

ops-bot: Reminder: add fallback behavior blurb: "If Dedicated capacity is constrained, requests may be routed to compatible Hosted variants with notification to AE."

legal: Please include this required footnote: "Availability, pricing and SLA are subject to contract and deployment configuration."

ari: Routing matrix suggestion (short & copyable):
```
if lead.regulated:
  route -> solutions@redwood
elif lead.expected_annual_commitment >= 50000 or lead.peak_rps >= 1000:
  route -> enterprise-ae@redwood
else:
  route -> growth@redwood
```

marco: Also add a customer checklist: data residency, compliance needs, expected qps, customization requirements, budget range. One column on the one-pager.

tess: Layout brief: single A4, two columns. Left column = checklist + routing box + quick CTA. Right column = three tiles with 2 bullets each + bench callouts. Footer: link to field playbook and contacts.

ari: Action items: 
- @tess: draft tile copy + checklist (due today EOD)
- @marco: add bench numbers and short explainer (due in 2 hours)
- @legal: confirm footnote phrasing (ASAP)
- @ari: assemble PDF and upload (after inputs)

ops-bot: Export queued: /drive/marketing/enterprise-snapshot-onepager/2001234567-draft.pdf

marco: Uploaded bench table and a short note about variance by seq length.

tess: Drafted tile copy and checklist, dropped into the doc. Link shared in drive.

ari: Assembling now. Review session Fri 10am PT. If you can't make it, comment inline. :mag:
